source.title: The solution of Hutník’s open problem

accepted.question_text: Let (X,A) be a measurable space, let F_(X,A) be the class of all A-measurable functions f:X->[0,1], and let M_(X,A) be the class of capacities mu:A->[0,1], meaning nondecreasing set functions with mu(empty set)=0 and mu(X)=1. A semicopula S:[0,1]^2->[0,1] is a binary operation that is nondecreasing in each coordinate and has neutral element 1. For such a semicopula define the smallest semicopula-based integral I_S(mu,f)=sup over t in [0,1] of S(t, mu({x in X: f(x)>=t})). Which semicopulas S have the translation-invariance property I_S(mu,f+a)=I_S(mu,f)+a for every measurable space (X,A), every capacity mu in M_(X,A), every measurable f in F_(X,A), and every a in [0,1] such that f+a is still [0,1]-valued?

evidence.page: HTML id Thmpr1.p1 and equation S1.E1
evidence.quote: Characterize a class of semicopulas S, for which the equality I_S(mu,f+a)=I_S(mu,f)+a holds for each (X,A), each (mu,f) and a.
